changelog:
Initial release of Work Productivity Agent Browser Workflow Helper.

- Provides practical workflows, checklists, and implementation support for Agent Browser-style tasks on Clawhub.
- Focuses on fixing bugs, improving reliability, safety, and hardening setups based on validated, broad user demand.
- Includes a consistent, user-centric workflow for restating requirements, planning, local-friendly implementation, artifact delivery, and validation.
- Outputs reusable templates, decision aids, and checklists for agent/productivity automation tasks.
- Clearly lists triggers, example prompts, and validation steps to ensure outputs meet user needs.
